HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
